scope: Primary-source inventory and exact dependency roles; not an exhaustive literature review

sources.title: RA-14: Optimal query complexity of spectral rank-k approximation
sources.publisher: Open Problems in Numerical Linear Algebra public repository
sources.version: Mutable main branch; source says last checked 2026-09-10
sources.role: Exact two-sided individual-vector oracle, pointwise 0.99 success, all simultaneous finite parameters.
sources.qualifier: No repository change made. Its public status is not independent validation of this package.

sources.title: Krylov Methods are (nearly) Optimal for Low-Rank Approximation
sources.role: Problem antecedent and general adaptive-to-Krylov lifting comparison.
sources.qualifier: The simulation grants a quadratic-sized family. No cost-preserving transfer is imported.

sources.title: Randomized block Krylov methods for approximating extreme eigenvalues
sources.role: Context for full block-Krylov spaces and error metrics.

sources.title: Uniform Error Estimates for the Lanczos Method
sources.role: Context for finite-dimensional polynomial error lower bounds.
sources.qualifier: Different eigenvalue error and probability statements; no all-adaptive RA-14 theorem imported and no priority comparison asserted.

sources.title: The gradient complexity of linear regression
sources.qualifier: The singular shifted posterior and averaged upper bound in this package are derived explicitly, not attributed to this paper.

sources.title: The smallest singular value of a random rectangular matrix
sources.venue: Communications on Pure and Applied Mathematics 62 (2009), 1707-1739
sources.role: Explicit external least-singular-value dependency of the inherited v5 lower bound.
sources.qualifier: Not a black-box dependency of the new restricted-class proof or the resolvent proof.

sources.title: Randomized Block Krylov Methods for Stronger and Faster Approximate Singular Value Decomposition
sources.role: Context for randomized spectral low-rank approximation and the preceding upper-bound construction.
sources.qualifier: The needed scale estimation and residual certificates are reproduced in Appendix B.

sources.title: Does block size matter in randomized block Krylov low-rank approximation?
sources.role: Checked later small/intermediate-block results, hidden logarithmic qualifiers, and input-perturbation mechanism.
sources.qualifier: The v2 version history was verified after initially reading v1. Its HTML rendering displays a later body date, which is not treated as an additional arXiv revision. No universal all-adaptive RA-14 theorem is imported.
